headline: Does Boeing’s (BA) FAA Win Signal the 737 MAX Turnaround Is Finally Underway?
summary: On July 17, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) delivered a massive regulatory milestone for The Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) by officially restoring the aerospace giant’s authority to issue airworthiness certificates for all newly produced 737 MAX and 787 Dreamliner aircraft.
